job.title: Telephone Assisted Voting / Call Centre Operators
job.description:
Call Centre & Telephone Assisted Voting Operators
Battery Point, Hobart | Short-term Temp Assignment 

Looking for work that makes a real contribution to your community?

Searson Buck is seeking enthusiastic and reliable people to support the Tasmanian Electoral Commission during the 2026 Local Government Elections.

We are recruiting a team of Call Centre and Telephone Assisted Voting (TAV) Operators to assist voters and support the delivery of election services across Tasmania. These are temporary opportunities based in Battery Point and are ideal for people with strong communication skills, attention to detail and a customer-focused approach. 

About the roles
You'll be part of a professional team supporting Tasmanians throughout the election period.

Depending on your placement, your responsibilities may include:
  • Responding to inbound calls and providing election information to members of the public
  • Assisting voters with Telephone Assisted Voting processes
  • Verifying information and following established procedures
  • Accurately entering and recording information across multiple systems
  • Working from scripts and structured processes
  • Providing a positive and professional customer experience
  • Maintaining confidentiality and accuracy at all times
Full training will be provided prior to commencement.

About you
To be successful, you'll have:
  • Excellent communication and listening skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Confidence using computers and navigating multiple systems
  • A friendly and professional telephone manner
  • The ability to follow instructions and established procedures
  • Reliability and a strong work ethic
  • Availability to attend training and work throughout the election period
Previous experience in customer service, contact centres, administration, hospitality, retail or election work will be highly regarded but is not essential. 
 
What's on offer?
  • $36.24 per hour, plus super
  • Valuable experience supporting a statewide election
  • A supportive team environment
  • The opportunity to contribute to an important public service
Key dates and availability requirements
Please ensure you are available for the relevant training and operational dates below. Different team members may be required at different stages, depending on the role assigned.

Telephone Assisted Voting (TAV) Operator
  • Mandatory training on 7 October 2026
  • Operational shifts commence from 8 October 2026
  • Full TAV team operational from 12 October 2026
  • Election period work continues through October 2026
  • Typical hours are Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 5:30pm
Important requirements
All successful applicants will be required to:
  • Complete pre-employment checks and reference checks
  • Complete a skills assessment
  • Provide evidence of Australian work rights
  • Meet the Tasmanian Electoral Commission's political neutrality requirements
  • Attend mandatory training sessions prior to commencement 
If you're looking for a rewarding short-term opportunity and enjoy helping people, we'd love to hear from you. For more information, please contact on Fon Palk (03 6270 2616) or fpalk@searsonbuck.com.au for a confidential discussion.
 
Apply now and play a part in supporting Tasmania's 2026 Local Government Elections.

Searson Buck is pleased to be recruiting on behalf of an established, client‑focused financial services firm supporting privately owned businesses.   • Strong technical knowledge across tax compliance for companies, trusts, individuals, and SMSFs
  • Experience reviewing work or providing supervision within an accounting team

The working environment
  • A well‑established and stable accounting practice with progression 
  • Clear workflows and defined areas of responsibility
  • A collaborative team environment with strong technical support
  • Flexible working arrangements, including remote or hybrid options
Remuneration

A salary range of $110,000-$140,000 plus benefits

 Join an award-winning firm where technical leadership, client relationships and career growth go beyond traditional compliance. Apply now and take the next step in your public practice career

job.title: Contracts & Projects Manager- Construction
job.description:
Our client is a respected and longstanding Tasmanian road surfacing contractor seeking a highly organised and commercially minded Contracts Supervisor to support the continued growth of their business.

This is a diverse role that combines tender preparation, contract administration, project coordination, quality oversight, business development and occasional field support, providing the opportunity to influence projects from opportunity identification through to final invoicing and close-out.

The role also provides scope to act as a SHEQ Champion, promoting safety, health, environment and quality awareness across operational activities.

About the Role
Reporting directly to the Manager, you will oversee the commercial and contractual lifecycle of projects while working closely with operations teams, clients, suppliers and subcontractors.
You will play a key role in securing new work, managing contract obligations, supporting project delivery and maintaining strong client relationships across local government, civil construction and private sector markets.

Key Responsibilities

Tendering & Estimating
  • Monitor tender portals and procurement opportunities.
  • Prepare and coordinate tenders, quotations and pricing submissions.
  • Develop high-quality tender documentation and capability statements.
  • Maintain tender registers and submission records.
  • Support pricing strategies for significant projects and contracts.
  • Support safe work practices by championing safety, health, environmental and quality across the business.
Contract Administration
  • Manage contracts from award through to final close-out.
  • Prepare progress claims, invoices and contract documentation.
  • Monitor project costs and identify variances.
  • Administer variations and contractual changes.
  • Maintain accurate project records and compliance documentation.
  • Coordinate project close-out, defect management and final claims.
Quality & Compliance
  • Support quality management processes throughout project delivery.
  • Assist with inspections, audits and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor quality records and non-conformance reporting.
  • Ensure adherence to WH&S and regulatory obligations.
  • Oversee the reporting, recording and follow-up of safety incidents, hazards and corrective actions to support timely resolution and continuous improvement
Business Development
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Identify upcoming opportunities and market trends.
  • Support business growth initiatives.
  • Represent the business professionally with clients and stakeholders.
Project & Operational Support
  • Provide occasional site-based support and project coordination.
  • Assist with scheduling, resource planning and logistics.
  • Support project teams with documentation and reporting.
  • Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers and traffic management arrangements.
About You

To be successful, you will bring: Experience in tendering, estimating, contract administration or project coordination within civil construction, road surfacing, infrastructure or related industries.
  • Strong understanding of construction contracts, variations, progress claims and project close-out processes.
  • Knowledge of civil construction or road surfacing operations.
  • Excellent written communication skills and experience preparing professional submissions and documentation.
  • Strong commercial awareness and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
  • Sound knowledge of WH&S requirements within construction environments.
  • Confidence in supporting safety reporting processes, hazard identification and incident escalation in a construction or operational environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • A current driver's licence.
Desirable
  • Qualifications in Civil Construction, Project Management, Contract Administration or a related field.
  • White Card.
  • Traffic Management training.
  • Experience within asphalt paving or spray sealing operations.
  • A current HR truck licence.
  • Experience with estimating, project management or contract management systems.
  • Knowledge of ISO quality management frameworks.
What's on Offer?
  • Join a recognised and well-established Tasmanian civil construction business.
  • Diverse role with genuine responsibility and autonomy.
  • Opportunity to influence business growth and project outcomes.
  • Supportive and experienced leadership team.
  • Long-term career opportunity within a stable industry.
  • Mix of office, client-facing and site-based activities.
Apply Now
If you're a commercially focused construction professional who enjoys working across tendering, contracts, project delivery and client relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

We're ideally looking for people available across the full election period.
  
About you
We're looking for people who can work in a fast, repetitive environment without losing focus. You'll need to be comfortable sitting at a workstation for extended periods and working as part of a team.
  
To be considered, you will need:
  • Strong data entry skills with a focus on speed and accuracy
  • The ability to meet minimum standards (around 7,000 keystrokes per hour with 90% accuracy)

  • Reliable availability across the project dates
  • A professional approach and ability to follow instructions
All workers must also be politically neutral and willing to complete the required declarations prior to commencing employment.
  
What’s on offer
  • Short-term project with clear timelines
  • Structured team environment with support on-site
  • Opportunity to be involved in an important statewide democratic process
  • Casual hourly rates in line with the Tasmanian State Service Award

Successful applicants will complete a short screening process, including a data entry skills assessment and availability check. This assessment helps ensure you're set up for success in the role.

job.title: Project Development Officer
job.description:
This northern-based client is seeking an experienced and motivated Project Development Officer to lead the planning, development and delivery of critical infrastructure projects across the municipality.
 
Reporting to the Director of Infrastructure, this role will play a key part in delivering road, bridge, footpath and stormwater programs that support a safe, sustainable and connected community.
 
Key responsibilities include:
  • Leading road renewal, reseal and footpath programs
  • Managing infrastructure projects from concept through to completion
  • Coordinating contractors, consultants, utilities and stakeholders
  • Preparing technical assessments, tender documentation and project specifications
  • Managing permits, regulatory approvals and road reserve applications
  • Supporting stormwater planning, asset renewal and long-term infrastructure strategies
  • Securing and managing grant-funded infrastructure projects
You will bring experience in civil engineering, infrastructure management or project delivery, along with strong communication, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills.
 
A degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline (or equivalent experience) is desirable.
 
This role will be offered on a temporary basis initially.
 
For a confidential conversation please call Nick Prokopiec on 0419 425 168 or email nprokopiec@searsonbuck.com.au
